content: We need number of CH3 groups in the compound. But we have no description of compound. Possibly we need to infer from NMR? We have no SMILES. We could request proton NMR spectra? But we don't know compound. Maybe the system expects we ask for carbon NMR? But we need CH3 count. Could be deduced from 13C NMR peaks for methyl carbons (~10-30 ppm). But we need the compound's structure? Not given. Perhaps the environment has a sample at hand (the "sample at hand") which is the compound. So we can request carbon NMR to see number of methyl carbon signals. Use carbon_nmr_spectra tool. That will give a string with peaks. Then count methyl signals. Let's do that.
